 UFC 334: Drew Dober vs. Chris Duncan Predictions & Odds
 Anatoly Pimentel 
 Nov 12, 2026, 10:58 PM 
 min read 
 (AP Photo/David Dermer) 
 The exciting lightweight clash between Drew Dober and Chris Duncan will be part of the UFC 334 card on Saturday at Madison Square Garden in New York. 
 Despite his two-fight win streak, Dober enters the match as the betting underdog with +155 UFC odds , while Duncan, who’s coming off a defeat in his previous fight, is going to be the -190 betting favorite. 
 UFC 334: Drew Dober vs. Chris Duncan Fight Odds 
 Drew Dober: +155 
 Chris Duncan: -190 
 UFC 334: Drew Dober vs. Chris Duncan: Tale of the Tape 
 table_builder($table) --> Drew Dober Chris Duncan 
 Age 38 33 
 Height 5’8” 5’10” 
 Reach 70 inches 71.5 inches 
 Leg Reach 35 inches 41 inches 
 Record 29-15 15-3 
 Fighting Style Freestyle Striker 
 Finishing Rate 76% 73% 
 UFC 334: Drew Dober vs. Chris Duncan: Prediction 
 I predict a decision win for Dober over Duncan because he’s the better overall striker with decent takedown defense. He has one-punch knockout power once he lands a clean shot. 
 Dober needs to keep the fight standing to stay a constant threat against Duncan. Meanwhile, Duncan has a clear grappling edge thanks to his relentless, high-pressure wrestling approach. 
 Despite this grappling advantage, I still think Dober can stop several takedowns and land more devastating strikes on the feet, especially since they are fighting in opposite stances, where Dober’s body kicks and hooks will be more available. 
 Drew Dober’s Recent Fight Results 
 Dober is a UFC veteran who has been with the promotion since 2014. However, he has only won two of his last five bouts, beating Kyle Prepolec and Michael Johnson and losing to Renato Moicano, Jean Silva, and Manuel Torres. 
 Chris Duncan’s Recent Fight Results 
 Duncan earned his UFC contract via Dana White’s Contender Series in August 2022. He won four of his last five bouts inside the octagon, defeating Bolaji Oki, Jordan Vucenic, Mateusz Gamrot, and Terrance McKinney. His lone defeat during this period was to Moicano.
